title: WWJD II: The Woodcarver
description: Matthew Stevenson has trouble accepting his parent's divorce and vents his anger by vandalizing a church. An old and godly widower takes Matthew under his wing to repair the damage, and helps him find faith.

title: Wish You Were Dead
description: After expressing her concerns about her dangerous ex-husband, a woman unintentionally ends up in a killing pact with two other people.

description: A woman finally gets her life back on track after the death of her fiancé. However, an old colleague then befriends her with the intention of making her his own, and will go to any cost to do so.

description: When Kendra wins a top award, her jealous twin sister Amber decides to take over Kendra's perfect life. As her life quickly starts to unravel, Kendra soon discovers her twin sister is the cause of her troubles.
